summary: Backend-only testing for the new /api/category-mapping/marketplaces endpoint fix. Ran the existing 5 unit tests plus added a new 5-test API integration suite that seeds/cleans MongoDB. All 10 tests pass. Endpoint contract verified: {total:N, items:[]} with sorted marketplace names. Empty state returns {total:0, items:[]}. Adjacent endpoints (new-count, sync-new POST with empty creds, sync-new/status) remain intact.
critical_code_review_comments: list_marketplaces() in category_mapping.py builds an intermediate list before sorted() and manually deduplicates in Python — for scale, prefer db.category_mapping_trees.distinct('marketplace') which pushes work to Mongo and is inherently deduped.

server.py file is now ~709 lines; approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting the category-mapping routes into a dedicated APIRouter module (e.g. routers/category_mapping.py) to keep server.py lean.

POST /api/category-mapping/sync-new accepts empty credentials silently and only fails asynchronously during the Playwright login. Consider adding a lightweight Pydantic validator (min_length=1) OR returning a 202-style response body clearly indicating 'will fail if credentials are missing' — the current behavior is contract-correct but user-hostile.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth required for these endpoints
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 docs into category_mapping_trees ('Test_Amazon','Test_Shopee','Test_ML') with empty categories arrays via module-scoped pytest fixture. Automatic cleanup via delete_many after tests. Verified endpoint returned {total:0, items:[]} post-cleanup on the public ingress.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new integration test file /app/backend/tests/test_category_mapping_marketplaces_api.py uses public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and connects directly to Mongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env) to seed 3 marketplaces. It cleans up after itself. Safe to re-run for regression. Frontend testing was intentionally skipped per E1's request.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs discovered. The fix is minimal (one new function list_marketplaces() + one new GET route) and satisfies all four requirements: (1) correct shape, (2) empty state, (3) seeded 3 marketplaces returned sorted, (4) adjacent endpoints unaffected.
